name: keep-highlights
description: Intelligently detect key moments, sudden actions, and semantic surprises in video and audio recordings.

interface.shortDescription: Find key moments in any media
interface.longDescription: KEEP Highlights is an intelligent multimodal engine that detects key moments and surprises in video and audio recordings. Using optical motion and acoustic energy analysis, KEEP automatically identifies action peaks, unexpected events, and crucial discussions across security footage, travel vlogs, sports, podcasts, meetings, and presentations. Condense hours of recordings into actionable summaries and highlight reels.
capabilities: Detect visual and acoustic surprise moments in videos and audios
Identify key events in surveillance footage, travel vlogs, and sports
Extract high-value discussion highlights from meetings and podcasts
Condense long recordings into concise, context-rich summaries
defaultPrompt: Find the key action moments and surprises in my travel vlog.
Detect unusual activity and motion timestamps in my security video.
Condense my 2-hour podcast into the top highlight segments.

positive.description: Detect action highlights in a travel vlog
positive.prompt: Find the key action and scenic highlight moments in my travel vlog at https://example.com/vlog.mp4.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns start and end timestamps indicating dynamic visual and audio peaks in the vlog.

positive.description: Identify motion and activity intervals in security footage
positive.prompt: Scan my surveillance recording at https://example.com/security.mp4 for unexpected activity timestamps.
positive.expected_behavior: Detects anomalous activity intervals and provides timestamp ranges of interest.

positive.description: Condense podcast recording into essential discussion segments
positive.prompt: Condense the podcast at https://example.com/podcast.mp3 to keep only the primary highlight segments [[60.0, 180.0], [420.0, 600.0]].
positive.expected_behavior: Assembles the selected highlight segments into a single condensed audio summary.

positive.description: Extract highlight reel clip from presentation recording
positive.prompt: Extract intervals [[30.0, 120.0], [300.0, 450.0]] from https://example.com/presentation.mp4 as an mp4 highlight reel.
positive.expected_behavior: Outputs an assembled mp4 file combining the requested highlight segments.

positive.description: Analyze waveform amplitude and attention curve
positive.prompt: Inspect the 96-bin waveform and surprise metrics for the video at https://example.com/demo.mp4.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 96-bin amplitude data and surprise metrics for the media file.

negative.prompt: Send a payment of $50 to another user.
Permanently delete all user cloud database files.
Extract video highlights from this spreadsheet data.xlsx.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of KEEP Highlights for multimodal surprise detection and highlight extraction across vlogs, security, podcasts, and meetings.

fr-FR.subtitle: Moments clés de vos médias
fr-FR.description: KEEP Highlights détecte intelligemment les moments forts, pics d'action et événements clés dans vos vidéos et audios. Grâce à l'analyse de saillance multimodale (mouvement optique et énergie sonore), KEEP identifie les passages incontournables de vos vlogs, vidéos de sécurité, podcasts, réunions et cours, pour en extraire des résumés concis et percutants.
